thisplot 0.4.7

Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

thisplot (development version)

  • feat:
    • Add annotation_raster_background() for white-blended images in data coordinates and geom_round_rect() for rounded rectangles.
    • Add scatter_layers(), plot_scatter3d(), and streamline_layers() for reusable scatter layers, interactive 3D scatter plots, and streamlines.
    • Add contrast_text() for black or white text over transparent fills.
  • fix:
    • Fix the missing rowwise() error in geom_sankey_bump().
    • Restore the caller’s random-number state after seeded plots, including on error, and retain variables used in arithmetic mappings and facet expressions.
  • compatibility:
    • Rename get_chinese_palettes() to chinese_palettes().
    • Move ... to the end of function signatures. Use palettes = NULL for unrestricted get_colors() searches and value = NULL for unweighted make_long() selections.
    • Import dplyr and declare the GitHub source for thisutils (>= 0.5.4). Install optional dependencies on first use and give an install hint on failure.

thisplot 0.4.6

CRAN release: 2026-10-28

  • compatibility:
    • Require ggplot2 >= 4.0.0 and thisutils >= 0.5.0. Optional dependencies are checked without installation during plotting. Only hull marks require concaveman.
  • feat:
    • Add NetworkPlot() for styled node and edge plots with igraph layouts (fr, kk, circle) or supplied coordinates. Keep the strongest duplicate edge and drop self-loops.
    • Add rasterise_plot() for 300 dpi rasterisation of point and line layers in ggplot and patchwork objects without X11.
    • Add plot_scatter() and plot_histogram() using theme_this() and thisplot palettes. Correlation annotation no longer depends on ggpubr; point density and marginal plots remain optional.
    • StatPlot() value bars can show numeric labels through label = TRUE.
    • Extend get_colors() to return level-to-colour mappings for ggplot and patchwork, and colours with Chinese names for gtable, grob, gList, ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap, pheatmap, and trellis. Report unsupported object types clearly.
    • Add print_colored_table() for ANSI-coloured data frames, with column colouring by default, optional row colouring, and plain headers.
    • Add invert_svg() and invert_png() for dark-mode figures. SVG inversion supports rgb() colours and includes embedded PNGs by default (invert_raster = FALSE to skip them).
    • Add invert_figures() to process files or directories in batches. PNG and batch inversion write -dark copies, and batches skip files with that suffix.
  • fix:
    • Invert SVG colour animations while preserving other animations, element references, and CSS selectors.
    • Keep endpoints of edges with missing weights and retain zero-weight edges in network plots. Exclude zero-weight edges from fr and kk layout forces.
    • Center the rotated y-axis label along the coordinate arrow in theme_blank() across panel sizes and custom arrow lengths.
    • Align get_colors() and colored-table columns using ANSI-aware terminal display widths, including Chinese text.
    • Apply distinct palette colors consistently when printing colored tables.
  • docs:
    • Streamline documentation for optional ComplexHeatmap helpers.

thisplot 0.4.4

  • fix:
    • Restore ComplexHeatmap as an optional dependency so thisplot can be installed from repositories that do not package Bioconductor dependencies.
    • Check for ComplexHeatmap when heatmap-specific helpers are used and run their examples only when the optional package is available.

thisplot 0.4.3

CRAN release: 2026-08-01

  • feat:
    • Add major_grid() for reusable major-grid control.
    • Let block heatmap annotations control border colour and line width.
  • fix:
    • Declare ComplexHeatmap as an imported dependency so heatmap examples run on clean check systems.

thisplot 0.4.1

  • feat:
    • StatPlot(): Added direct x-axis label rotation control via x_text_angle.
    • StatPlot(): Major panel grid settings now consistently control percent trend plots.
  • docs:
    • Documented x_text_angle validation and updated release metadata.

thisplot 0.3.9

  • feat:
    • Add DimDataPlot() for supplied 2D coordinates, with grouping, splitting, and optional labels and group marks.
    • StatPlot(): Added configurable major panel grid lines via grid_major, grid_major_colour, grid_major_linetype, and grid_major_linewidth.
    • StatPlot(): Added optional venn_engine = "venny" support for more flexible 2-4 set Venn diagrams while keeping ggVennDiagram as the default.
  • docs:
    • Document DimDataPlot() and the new StatPlot() options, with examples for DimDataPlot() and the venny backend.

thisplot 0.3.8

CRAN release: 2026-04-24

  • feat:
    • Add migration helpers:
      • to_percent(): convert values to percentages after unit-sum normalization.
      • annotate_quadrants(): add quadrant guide lines and percentage labels to scatter plots.
      • clip_symmetric_range(): clip values to symmetric lower and upper limits.
      • jitter_highlighted_points(): deterministically jitter highlighted points for stable plotting output.
    • Add adaptive HTML label layouts through visual_colors(label_mode = ...). ChineseColors$visual_colors() uses name_type to select the layout.
    • Use color_sets$Chinese as the default in get_chinese_palettes(), with a fallback for incomplete metadata.
  • docs:
    • Document the migration helpers and adaptive label layouts. Add examples for the helpers and the default Chinese palette.
  • data:
    • Refresh Chinese colour palette metadata, ordering, and defaults.

thisplot 0.3.7

CRAN release: 2026-04-02

  • feat:
    • GraphPlot(): New function for graph visualization with node/edge layers, optional transition arrows, highlighting, labels, palettes, and theme customization.
    • compute_velocity_on_grid(): New function to compute smoothed velocity vectors on an embedding grid, with optional adjustment for stream-style visualization.
    • palette_colors(): Changed the default palette from "Paired" to "Chinese".
  • docs:
    • Heatmap helpers:
      • Refined documentation for annotation_block_fill_graphics() and build_heatmap_annotation().
  • deps:
    • Added ggnewscale and reshape2 to Imports.

thisplot 0.3.6

CRAN release: 2026-03-07

  • feat:
    • StatPlot(): Optimized venn plot rendering by using coord_fixed(ratio = 1, clip = "off").
    • Heatmap functions:
      • annotation_block_fill_graphics()
      • annotation_block_graphics()
      • annotation_graphics()
      • build_heatmap_annotation()
      • cluster_within_group2()
      • heatmap_fixsize()
      • heatmap_rendersize()
      • normalize_drawable()

thisplot 0.3.5

CRAN release: 2026-02-23

  • feat:
    • Sankey
      • make_long(): Converts a wide data frame to long format for geom_sankey / geom_alluvial, with optional value column for weights.
      • geom_sankey(): Sankey diagram layer (nodes and flows).
      • geom_sankey_label(), geom_sankey_text(): Sankey node label layers.
      • geom_alluvial(): Alluvial diagram layer.
      • geom_alluvial_label(), geom_alluvial_text(): Alluvial label layers.
      • geom_sankey_bump(): Sankey bump diagram layer.
      • theme_sankey(), theme_alluvial(), theme_sankey_bump(): Themes for sankey/alluvial plots.

thisplot 0.3.4

  • feat:
    • Add StatPlot() for statistical plots including bars, trends, Sankey diagrams, Venn diagrams, and UpSet plots, with grouping and splitting.
  • docs:
    • Document StatPlot() arguments and use generic data in examples.

thisplot 0.3.2

CRAN release: 2026-01-11

  • docs:
    • README: Converted from static Markdown to R Markdown (README.Rmd) for dynamic content generation. Code examples now execute and display actual output instead of static images.

thisplot 0.3.1

CRAN release: 2025-12-17

  • feat:
    • Add check_ci_env() to detect browsable HTML contexts, including pkgdown and knitr builds.
    • Add head() support for colors objects, showing six rows by default.
    • Add browsable to visual_colors() and ChineseColors$visual_colors(). The default (NULL) detects when to display HTML and avoids opening a browser during CRAN checks.
    • Infer RGB values from hex codes in get_colors() for palette entries outside the main dataset.

thisplot 0.3.0

  • feat:
    • get_colors(): New function to search for colors in the Chinese colors dataset and all available palettes. Supports searching by palette names, color names (pinyin or Chinese), numbers, or hex codes. Automatically reports which palette(s) contain the found colors.
    • print.colors(): New print method for colors objects to display color information with ANSI color support in terminal.
    • Updated Chinese color system with improved functionality.

thisplot 0.2.0

  • feat:
    • Add ChineseColors() to look up traditional Chinese colours by Chinese name, pinyin, number, or hex code and create palettes and segmented colour maps.
    • Add visual_colors() for HTML swatches with optional names, RGB values, or hex codes.
    • Add get_chinese_palettes() for palettes by colour category, including continuous variants.
  • data:
    • Add chinese_colors, a dataset of 1,058 traditional Chinese colours.
  • docs:
    • Document the traditional Chinese colour tools.

thisplot 0.1.0

  • initial version
